name: Daliani: Living Tradition
summary:
In Daliani: Living Tradition, you become Apostolis, a 17-year-old visiting his uncle Petros at a traditional fishing installation in Preveza for the first time.

From the viewpoint on the tower, you listen to local fishermen, answer dialogue prompts, and learn how the net, winches, timing, and observation shape the Daliani fishing method. Use the mechanisms to prepare the trap, watch fish move through the water, and choose the right moment to close the net, to ensure the most successful catch.
